finding: The current equation endpoint already requires formula literacy and atom/mass conservation but does not explicitly require the separate pure-compound fixed-composition foundation. proposal: One explicit prior didactic concept for the same unchanged equation competence; no stronger new unrelated stoichiometric-calculation or laboratory duty is appended to the constant-composition goal.
scientificLimits: Mass conservation, fixed compound composition and quantitative reaction calculations are not equivalent competencies.
This is a proposed learning sequence, not a claim that all equation algorithms logically require numerical mass-ratio calculation.
A foreign reviewer must decide whether this prerequisite is genuinely useful and justified, rather than an edge added just for source-gate success. Reject if that didactic dependency is not sound.
